name: claude-kit
description: Ticket-to-merge workflow for Claude Code: architecture discussion, worktree setup, TDD, automated PR review, and the design vocabulary that keeps behavior on the right object.

plugins.name: kit
plugins.description: End-to-end GitHub ticket workflow. /kit:architect runs the problem conversation and files lean issues; /kit:design settles the how and writes the plan; /kit:ship-ticket drives TDD through PR with gates you answer, and /kit:run-ticket does the same unattended, parking any ticket whose plan no longer holds. Ships an opt-in PostToolUse hook that posts a Claude review on the PRs you open, registered per project.
